posts.text: Can a hitter tell what pitch is coming from where it leaves the pitcher’s hand? I've always loved baseball and a hot topic recently is pitch tunneling, or how pitchers make different pitches look the same before they break apart. I wanted to know whether release point plays a role, so I analyzed three seasons of MLB pitching data in Python to see what I could find.
